eps.ov: The Phantomhive estate bustles with preparations for an important meeting between the Young Master and a slithering captain of industry. The maid, the gardener, and the cook are fools, but the Butler is a man of hidden talents.
eps.oa: تعج ضيعة آل «فانتومهايف» بالاستعدادات للقاء مهم بين السيد الصغير وأحد كبار الصناعيين المراوغين. والخادمة والبستاني والطاهي حمقى، لكن كبير الخدم رجل ذو مواهب خفية.

eps.ov: Plans to suppress an uprising of the vermin variety are put on hold when the Young Master is abducted. The Butler is obligated to act decisively in such matters, and no one sets the table better than Sebastian.
eps.oa: تتأجل خطط قمع انتفاضة من صنف الهوام حين يُختطف السيد الصغير، وكبير الخدم ملزم بالتصرف بحزم في أمور كهذه، ولا أحد يعد المائدة أفضل من «سيباستيان».

eps.ov: When the Young Master’s fiancée drops by for an unannounced visit, the Phantomhive Estate experiences a sickening outbreak of “cuteness.” Meanwhile, the Butler has his hands full with a suicidal apprentice.
eps.oa: حين تزور خطيبة السيد الصغير ضيعة آل «فانتومهايف» دون موعد، تجتاحها موجة مقززة من «اللطافة». وفي الأثناء ينشغل كبير الخدم بمتدرب يائس.

eps.ov: The Young Master dons an evening gown to apprehend a monster who’s been butchering women of the night, but if his talent for cross-dressing is discovered, the Phantomhive name will be irreversibly sullied.
eps.oa: يرتدي السيد الصغير ثوب سهرة نسائياً للإيقاع بوحش يقتل النساء في الأزقة ليلاً، لكن إن انكشف تنكره فسيتلطخ اسم آل «فانتومهايف» إلى الأبد.

eps.ov: The Butler and his Young Master scour the seedy back alleys of London in search of an infamous butcher. Imagine their surprise upon discovering that the ripper may actually be a reaper!
eps.oa: يجوب كبير الخدم وسيده الصغير أزقة لندن الخلفية المشبوهة بحثاً عن سفاح سيئ الصيت. فتخيّل دهشتهما حين يكتشفان أن السفاح قد يكون حاصد أرواح!

eps.ov: Sebastian continues his gruesome battle with the rogue reaper, and the Young Master takes special care to ensure that his beloved aunt is buried in the proper colors.
eps.oa: يواصل «سيباستيان» معركته الضارية مع حاصد الأرواح المارق، ويحرص السيد الصغير حرصاً خاصاً على أن تُدفن خالته الحبيبة بالألوان اللائقة.

eps.ov: At the behest of the Queen, the Young Master and his underlings travel to a dreary land supposedly haunted by a demon dog. This new mission makes the Butler uneasy, but he’s always been more of a cat person.
eps.oa: بأمر من الملكة يسافر السيد الصغير وخدمه إلى أرض كئيبة يُقال إن كلباً شيطانياً يسكنها. وتقلق هذه المهمة الجديدة كبير الخدم، فهو أميل إلى القطط.

eps.ov: The Butler puts on an exhibition in the art of training demonic canines to shake, roll over, and refrain from terrorizing gloomy villages. Meanwhile, the Gardener gets his first, painful taste of love.
eps.oa: يقدم كبير الخدم عرضاً في فن تدريب الكلاب الشيطانية على المصافحة والتقلب والكف عن ترويع القرى الكئيبة. وفي الأثناء يذوق البستاني أول طعم مؤلم للحب.

eps.ov: The Young Master’s latest acquisition is a haunted camera which can photograph beings not of this world. Calamites are sure to follow when the servants set out to snap a shot of the elusive Butler.
eps.oa: أحدث مقتنيات السيد الصغير آلة تصوير مسكونة تلتقط صور كائنات ليست من هذا العالم. ولا بد أن تتوالى المصائب حين ينطلق الخدم لالتقاط صورة لكبير الخدم المراوغ.

eps.ov: Already a man of many talents, the Butler adds ice sculpting to his repertoire in an attempt to acquire a priceless-but-cursed gem for his Young Master.
eps.oa: يضيف كبير الخدم، صاحب المواهب الكثيرة أصلاً، نحت الجليد إلى قائمة براعاته، في محاولة للحصول على جوهرة لا تقدر بثمن لكنها ملعونة لسيده الصغير.

eps.ov: When his betrothed is abducted by a deranged doll maker, the Young Master travels to London to investigate. Little does he know, the search will be complicated by a lovesick reaper who’s lost his scythe.
eps.oa: حين يختطف صانع دمى مختل خطيبة السيد الصغير، يسافر إلى لندن ليتحرى الأمر. ولا يدري أن البحث سيتعقد بسبب حاصد أرواح متيم أضاع منجله.

eps.ov: The Master’s birthday approaches, but rescuing Elizabeth is of far greater importance than celebrating. A vile puppeteer is terrorizing London, and only the Butler can cut down his army of marionettes.
eps.oa: يقترب عيد ميلاد السيد، لكن إنقاذ «إليزابيث» أهم بكثير من الاحتفال. فمحرك دمى خسيس يروّع لندن، ولا أحد غير كبير الخدم يقدر على حصد جيش دماه.

eps.ov: A postcolonial conflict boils over when an Indian prince visits the Phantomhive estate. Later, the Butler’s prowess with a blade is unexpectedly matched by his foreign counterpart.
Prince Soma has been betrayed by his manservant, and the Butler must put his hellish talents to the test in a curry-cooking competition against the blessed right hand of an Indian deity.

The Queen is on hand as the Butler wages culinary warfare against Prince Soma’s royal servant. The competition reaches an unprecedented level of ferocity when someone’s secret ingredient unleashes the demon god of curry.

eps.t: His Butler, in an Isolated Castle
eps.ov: When the Young Master is defeated in a supernatural chess match, he must surrender his most prized possession to a ghostly prince. Locating a very old and very specific skull is the key to bringing Sebastian back.
The Queen orders young Master Phantomhive to investigate reports of a cult that promises to “purify” its unclean members. The mission is complicated by the appearance of a familiar reaper.
An angel abducts Ciel and attempts to rewrite his unhappy memories of the past. The Butler is powerless to assist, but fortunately, the Young Master has an unhealthy attachment to his hatred.

There’s a potent new drug plaguing the backstreets of London, and it’s being sold in stolen Phantomhive candy wrappers. The Young Master is being set up, but what manner of man wants him to take the fall?
While the Young Master continues his investigation into the opium-filled, counterfeit candy wrappers, the Butler is chained and tortured in the Tower of London.
A series of flashbacks reveals the secret pasts - and hidden talents - of the Phantomhive staff. While the servants go about their daily duties, the Young Master gives a chess lesson to pretty lady.

The Young Master’s journey to Paris leads to another showdown with the Queen’s angelic butler and a painful parting of the ways with someone dear to his heart. Can Ciel survive without the demonic assistance he’s grown so accustomed to?

The Young Master arrives in London only to find the city engulfed by flames. After an ominous warning from the undertaker, Ciel attempts to visit the queen, but he’s shocked by his treatment at the hands of the palace guards.
Having regained the services of his Butler, the Young Master issues a chilling order to kill. Sebastian is eager to please, but this task will require a revelation of his true nature.
